Flow.description: 4-7-26 Removing Close Date calc from this flow to handle in the upstream Account - After Save - General flow for closed won opps. It causes logic issues due to location project child accounts triggering closed-won. 4-3-26 adding Opp location -> LocationId requirement to leave Demo stage (plus other rule fixes from Location project UAT) 3-27-26 Changing Opp stage requirements per requests from sales leaders 7-28-25 added logic in the missing info steps to support ENT needs on opps 7-21-25 added D22 about next step date stamp 3-24-25 added exception to Demo exit requirement rules to allow Closed Lost stage 3-19-25 Added D21 to ensure no Sales Opp can skip Demo stage an must have all relevant data populated prior to moving forward. 3-13-25 Added D20 logic for Pro Pool rules when leaving demo (note steering of all sales record types) 3-13-25 Added Opportunity Source Requirement for Sales type Opps 2-4-25 changed broken logic for contact role check and Strategic AE perm check 1-22-25 added Talent Fusion Opportunity logic for Closed Won 12-18-24 Bug fixed in which Closed Lost status led to a null value in Close Date 12-10-24 Adding nuance to the calculation of Closed Won date for Sales Opportunities (if First Job Completed, match that date) 12-5-24 Removing additional discovery Account fields from Sales Opportunity requirements for exiting Discovery 11-22-24 Changed D15 logic to allow MEDDICC fields to remain blank on Assignment type opps (not talent fusion) 11-20-24 Adding AM Sales Opportunity requirements including Beds/ OP Rooms / Procedure Rooms distinction 10-24-24 - Adding D13 to prevent moving from Discovery stage without certain requirements, or skipping Discovery 10-22-24 - Adding D12 to provide criteria for Opportunity Creation 10-2-24 - fixing a bug which misrecognizes the ID of the System Admin profile when preventing updates to scheduled flows 9-3-2024 - Added D08-09 which check if an updated Sales Opportunity has any Opportunity Contact Roles, and if not, halts the flow and shows a custom error message. 8-21-2024 - Replaced SDR stamp automation with new on-create automation for Sales Opps which stamps GSV period at Close based on Facility Type
